mapper.select: SELECT SALES_NUMBER , CUSTOMER_NAME , CASE WHEN CUSTOMER_PHONE IS NULL OR CUSTOMER_PHONE = '' THEN '-' ELSE CUSTOMER_PHONE END AS CUSTOMER_PHONE , SALE_DATE , MODEL_COLOR , MODEL_NAME , MODEL_PRICE FROM SALES_INFO S, CAR_INFO C WHERE S.MODEL_NUMBER = C.MODEL_NUMBER ORDER BY SALE_DATE DESC;
